content: A nyimi tomore tonname a Yohana o batisma wa suri awa ya zoola a nyimi wake o makeke ma Yahudiya,
aa wa beyana, “Kurǝ na Ashili, obena togomo te shili te amara
Ondoonaa Ishaya ondo beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wa beke angmǝ azaa wai na:

content.text: “Lengmelo ya rara owake ale beya na,

content: A soo madibi ma Yohana ka sezǝru se orongkoomea, awa tera o tinǝ owai ka lejǝng le ongma. A epaolya wai eya ekangdang ka mato ma esheng.
Na aromo a Urushalima, kaa a makeke ma Yahudiya a pate, kaa a pate ana makeke ma Obeno Urdung ne deese ara a kai,
ane beeze madinǝ mane, aa wa ezene obatisma Obeno Urdung.
Pate ka nyimi nangka Yohana wa laka maParisa ka maSadukiya araaka waya eza aromo obatisma, nawa bekaa ne na, “Ying okurkǝnǝng ewa eburu! Mana wa zoola aying na esong o gǝǝzǝ o Ashili ka waya deya?
Ezana epaaka eyo ale akap ka ewore obena e kurǝ Ashili aying.
Kangza tane ole begeshe na, ‘Ibraheng waya ate aro ne.’ Ang bele ying na, Ashili aye ka obare o sǝǝrǝ Ibraheng ayana a nyimi a caleena.
A samba o eke betemo aa madǝrǝ ma o mati, kangza pate uti ka wata ngmengza ayana a rerene, ayo genda wai ka tare a nyimi ola.

“Mi ang ezeze ying o batisma ka manyia o wore o kurǝ a Ashili aying. Malo ong ondo ya deya kawa kalang o bare, tekakau te wai ma era anta bare ang monte ne. Wayo eza ying o batisma ka Obere Ashili ka ola.
Waya onta upkwi owai a taara, aa wa keleke epaolya wai, aa wa kare o eyo me a nyimi lebengga, aa wa ese masuni mame ka ola ka wata lambuzu ne.”
A were name na Yeso deya ka suri a Galili a ale a Urdung ara Yohana adorana wa eze kai o batisma.
Na Yohana yeme o nara kai, awa bekaana, “Mi ang gwara obekaana bo oyeng o batisma, eyaaka bo ba deya ara ang?”
Na Yeso kabare wai na, “Baya wa itǝ nyimi nanname, aza obena nyimi a kala orera ka te panza epa e sangsang eeka Ashili ya yeme me.” Na Yohana kabare, aa wa ye kai o batisma.
Malo o eza Yeso o batisma, ka osurǝ kai a nyimi manyi naname, a saseya na zaa shili banggalanu, aka laka Obere o Ashili a jǝpi na kagoma, aka jǝpi ukpwei kai.
Na kone lengmelo a surǝ zaa shili na, “Kannaa kena kang, kamea ang yeme, kamea ang kone oleba kai maleu.”
